_about: Renderer-only material hints, keyed by GLB material name. They never reach the game files. anisotropy.mode: uv-radial (grooves are circles around uv 'center', e.g. records and spun metal mapped with uv_radial), tangent (grooves run along U, e.g. brushed metal), model-radial (circles around the model's Z axis at model-space 'center'). roughness_across = perceptual roughness across the grooves; along the grooves the material's own roughness is used. mask_roughness [lo, hi] fades the effect in where the roughness map is between lo and hi (records: grooves are rougher than the smooth track gaps). Other keys: roughness, metallic, base_color [r,g,b(,a)] linear (multiplies the base texture), emissive_scale, normal_scale, base_texture / mr_texture / normal_texture: false to drop that map (try a finish without touching the model).
